text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"No... this won't do at all.
At this rate, I can't catch up, let alone pass them!"
choice_data_list: I-I-It's okay! You'll get it next time!
Let's train and push ourselves to the limit.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Heh... hahahahaha!
It really is true that seeing someone crazier
than yourself calms you down!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"No, was it because I lost my composure?
My bad. But thanks to that, I've calmed down now."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's reset!
If you need a comeback, leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Just you watch...
I'll sink my teeth into victory and never let go!
